name: Nam Botanica
description: Practitioner-formulated herbal self-care brand founded by Mimi, built around botanical teas and plant-based skin and hair topicals. Its own Affiliate Program page offers 10% commission on every referred order through UpPromote, with a personal link, exclusive discount codes and early product access. The page states the cap explicitly twice — 'No cap' on the commission and 'There's no ceiling on your earnings' — so commission_cap is recorded as verified uncapped.

evidence.summary: Nam Botanica's own Affiliate Program page ('Earn 10% on every sale you refer') routes applications to its UpPromote portal (af.uppromote.com). It welcomes creators, practitioners, bloggers and podcasters, is free to join, and applications are reviewed within 3–5 business days.

The brand's own page states the cap explicitly: 'Every customer you refer earns you a 10% commission on their order. No cap, no minimum threshold to get started' and, under Grow with us, 'The more you share, the more you make. There's no ceiling on your earnings' — so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped. No absolute creator counts are published, so creator_saturation stays unknown.
The brand's About page describes founder Mimi's background in nutrition and Chinese Medicine and the product lines: organic herbal teas plus plant-based skin topicals and hair topicals.

reasons.ugc_evidence: The program explicitly recruits content creators, bloggers and podcasters, with a personal tracked link, audience discount codes and early product access.
reasons.compensation: 10% on every order with an explicit no-cap / no-ceiling statement on the brand's own page — verified uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own page into UpPromote; no public program email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free and publicly open to apply; the brand states it responds within 3–5 business days and values authenticity over audience size.
reasons.credibility: Small, young practitioner-led brand with a real storefront and a detailed program page, but limited track record.
